messages.author: Hashemi, Mohtadin
messages.body:
Good afternoon,
I noticed a small typo in update.13 for AmberTools20 (
https://ambermd.org/bugfixes/AmberTools/20.0/update.13
):
+ sm80flags-'-gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80'
Should be:
+ sm80flags='-gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80'
/MH
